row.proto: void Career_Start_UpgradeResearch(void *upgrades, uint32_t owner, void *inst, uint32_t start_day, uint16_t end_day, uint8_t option, uint8_t roll_failure, void *rng, uint8_t store_duration)
row.notes: U-level research start (rcx Upgrades, edx owner entrant key, r8 instance, r9d start day, [rsp+0x20] u16 end day, +0x28 option, +0x30 roll failure, +0x38 rng (mt19937, read only when roll and inst+0x7c==0xff), +0x40 store duration). Pushes InProgress (2), +0x7e/+0x80 start/end day, +0x88 fail flag (+0x8a delay, +0x8c midpoint in upgrades+8==2 mode); in mode 2 mirrors the start onto the same-id instances of the other owners; end==start clears the fail flag and runs 0x143523a40: Completed (3) when DAT_1460fc310<2, PendingDevelopment (6) when ==2, never Failed. Then fitted-ratio post (fitted=1) only if the latest state is Completed (0x14352fc10 if PendingDevelopment), availability refresh when upgrades+8 is 1 or 2 (mode 0 sets +0x1aa8=0x3fff0000), upgrades-changed bus message. No RP here; callers 0x1412431a0 (after RP debit), 0x14105f800, 0x1412447b0, Car_Fit_UpgradesToRating 0x143514670, 0x14352f060 (wording: ce-verify-1 V0237)
